workflow.round_gate: Critical=0 and Major=0 after independent verification; all Minor closed or waived with written reason in round 3

checks.check: Task inputs, outputs, operating assumptions and claim boundary are explicit and consistent with the title.
Every claimed component has a controlled ablation with all other inputs held fixed.
Strong current baselines use equal candidate/context budgets and equivalent tuning opportunity.
Validator never observes gold SQL/answers and all repair operations are bounded and traced.
Oracle-label, predicted-label and label-blind protocols are separated; oracle is not presented as end-to-end.
Statistical unit and cluster match the data-generating process; C2 uses true document_id.
Paired comparisons use identical instances and report absolute effect and 95% CI.
Binary paired outcomes use exact McNemar or justified alternative; multiplicity uses Holm.
Seed counts, dispersion, failures and excluded pairs are reported without best-seed selection.
Negative/non-significant results trigger wording downgrade rather than subset or metric switching.
No source group, document, template family or derived sibling leaks across frozen splits.
Every dataset has source, license/use boundary, checksum, extraction script and derivation record.
Synthetic/AI-assisted content is identified and its human audit rate and conflict procedure are disclosed.
Gold SQL executes deterministically and result hashes match; sealed instances were not development-touched.
NERC is called human-gold only if real qualified humans independently reviewed the registered amount.
The manuscript identifies the grid professional, workflow stage, decision supported and failure consequence.
Schemas, terminology, queries and safety rules are credible for maintenance/operations databases.
Five causal roles match reliability-report practice and role confusions are interpreted operationally.
Extreme/failure cases and conditions under which the method should not be deployed are explicit.
The paper presents concrete applied validation beyond idealized single-case accuracy.
Terminology and method are readable to a multidisciplinary Computing and AI audience.
Sensitivity, robustness, efficiency and honest limitations accompany headline performance.
Structure and evidence density are calibrated to the 10-paper sample without calling sample budgets journal rules.
Every main figure/table answers an RQ and every main numerical value traces to an E4 artifact.
Error bars, sample size, units, direction of improvement and statistical notation are unambiguous.
Figures are color-blind safe, grayscale distinguishable, readable at final width and exported at required resolution.
Framework diagrams have distinct purposes and do not repeat decorative boxes.
Results and Discussion explain mechanism, engineering meaning, failure boundary and not merely restate values.
No plausible leakage, circular label construction, test tuning or unfair baseline can explain the headline result.
Claims remain defensible under the strongest baseline, alternate metric and worst relevant subgroup.
Novelty is framed as a validated applied combination and does not overclaim algorithmic novelty.
Reproduction from an empty output directory regenerates registered tables and figures.
Every quantitative sentence maps to experiment ID, canonical row key, statistic and figure/table.
Every literature claim has a directly supporting, verified source; no citation laundering.
MA-SQLGrid and C2GES do not duplicate data contribution, result, prose, figure or first-claim.
Title, abstract, contributions, results and conclusion use the same evidence-bounded claim strength.
MDPI source compiles cleanly with no undefined citations/references, missing assets or placeholders.
Author Contributions, Funding, Data Availability, Conflicts, ethics and AI-use disclosures are complete and truthful.
Supplementary files, code/data availability boundaries, licenses and checksums agree with the manuscript.
References are sequential MDPI style; captions, abbreviations, units and equations are internally consistent.
Current Applied Sciences instructions, Section fit and submission requirements were reverified from official pages.
